verses.text: When Ephraim spoke, people trembled. He was honored in Israel. But he became guilty by worshiping Baal, and he died.

Now they keep on sinning more and more. They melt their silver to make idols, cleverly shaped images, all of them the work of craftsmen. People say about them, "Those who offer human sacrifices kiss the calf idols!"
So they will disappear like the morning mist, like the dew that vanishes early, like chaff blown from a threshing floor, like smoke escaping through a window.
"But I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt. You must know no God but me. There is no savior except me.
I took care of you in the wilderness, in a land of burning heat.
When I fed them, they were satisfied. When they were satisfied, they became proud. Then they forgot me.
So I will attack them like a lion. Like a leopard, I will lie in wait beside the road.
Like a bear robbed of her cubs, I will attack them and rip them open. I will devour them there like a lioness. Like a wild animal, I will tear them apart.
"Israel, you are destroyed because you are against me, your helper.
Where is your king now, who can save you in all your cities? Where are your rulers, about whom you said, 'Give us a king and leaders'?
In my anger I gave you a king, and in my fury I took him away.
Ephraim's guilt is stored up. His sins are kept on record.
Pain like a woman in labor comes on him, but he is a foolish child. When the time comes, he does not come out of the womb.
"Should I rescue them from the power of the grave? Should I save them from death? Death, where are your plagues? Grave, where is your destruction? I will show them no pity.

Even though Ephraim does well among his brothers, an east wind will come from the LORD, blowing in from the desert. His spring will fail, and his well will dry up. His treasures will be stripped away.

The people of Samaria must bear their guilt, because they have rebelled against their God. They will be killed by the sword. Their little children will be dashed to the ground, and their pregnant women ripped open."
